geometry.geometry_revision: user supplied input.json; original 28 vertices, 48 triangular panels, 2 quadrilateral roofs, 76 edges

frames.fea_frame: Right-handed; bottom roof center at (0,0,0), upper roof center at (0,0,0.0264); +Z points toward upper roof
frames.isaac_frame: Right-handed Z-up; floor top Z=-0.005 m; neutral knee local-to-world mapping plus analytic whole-leg root translation

source_to_fea.equation: p_fea = scale * R * p_source + translation; no reflection

transform_fea_to_isaac.preview_root_translation_m: [0,0,0.0339 - 0.5*9.81*t^2] for the current neutral leg; recomputed from world-space foot/floor bounds at preview entry

frames.zero_definition: Original folded JSON neutral shape, zero cable tensions; release from rest
frames.positive_angle_direction: Right-hand rotation-vector components of the bottom cap relative to fixed upper cap. Pattern names identify cable families, not Euler-angle signs.
frames.compression_sign: Positive bottom cap Z translation shortens cap separation.

material.model: Provisional isotropic linear elasticity; perfect PLA/PET bond; no measured stock-grade identification
material.gap_selection: Owner requested least practical exposure. 0.1/0.2/0.4 mm numerical candidates only; manufacturing minimum and optimum NOT established.
material.application_to_drop: Retained cable FEM constants for reference only; not used to evaluate impact stress or failure

mesh.element_type: Quadratic TET10, four-point Gauss integration, physical PET and PLA thickness
mesh.characteristic_length_note: Highly nonuniform layered mesh; physical film thickness 80e-6 m, exposed gap 200e-6 m. No single representative element length.
mesh.convergence_summary: FAIL: refinement 3->4 compression +15.6811%; PET reference volume +0.765862% across 1->4. Entire reference laminate geometry is not held fixed.

boundary_conditions: Whole leg initially upright, foot first, released from rest; no external fixed upper-cap support in the analytic translation preview
70 mm initial clearance from lowest foot point to rigid horizontal floor top
All parts translated as one undeformed assembly during ideal uniform-gravity free fall
Quasistatic cable controller suspended and diagnostics deactivated for preview; unloaded FEM restored on Return
STOP at first contact; no post-impact integration, rebound or stress/failure result

loads.mass_provenance: User authorized provisional small-robot example, not measured or optimized; 30/20 g partition includes knee and plates; no inertia tensor or element density inferred

solver.software: Analytic free-fall preview in Isaac Sim Kit; no dynamic impact FEM
solver.stopping_rule: Clamp t to sqrt(2h/g); hold rendered pose at first contact without extrapolating impact forces

limitations: Quasistatic FEM has no mass/inertia or transient impact integration
No foot contact, self-contact, impact damping or restitution model
No calibrated rate-dependent PLA/PET failure or adhesive separation law
Mesh response is unconverged; PET reference volume changes with refinement
Measured mass distribution, material coupons and impact data are unavailable

review.notes: Operational and analytic checks passed; mesh validation failed; structural survival unassessed. Canonical v8/v9 and old FEA manifests unchanged.

reproduction.controls: 70 mm drop preview (no impact FEM) > Replay 70 mm; Return to cable FEM restores unloaded workshop
